criteria.GDN-039-AC01: Seven independent exact-revision dimensions and read-only display; no aggregate verified badge, probability or publication claim.
criteria.GDN-039-AC02: Domain and SQL role/state guards, optimistic version, author conflicts, receipt-bound assignment and current purpose permission.
criteria.GDN-039-AC03: Append-only reopened disputes preserve earlier events and verbatim legacy labels without promoting them.

local_validation: Domain/repository/registry tests; actual PostgreSQL and browser evaluation is pending for this candidate.
activation: No HTTP routes, private records, publication or new hosting activated.
digest_profile: postgres-jsonb-text-sha256 for a working revision, not a claim to original archival byte hashing.
migration: 0011 additive and checksum-locked; not applied to Neon.
limitations: Recorded-author conflict prevention is not a guarantee of undisclosed independence.
Current purpose permission is not legal adjudication or rights verification.
Release recommendation remains distinct from publication approval.
Operator-controlled database history is not independently anchored.
